recipes.name: Hoisin Sauce
recipes.flavorProfile: Thick, sweet and savory, with garlic, a little heat and five-spice warmth.
recipes.healthBenefit: Fermented soybean paste brings protein and flavor; the sauce is sweet and salty, so a little goes far.

ingredients.prepNote: fermented soybean paste

ingredients.baseName: Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)

ingredients.prepNote: 2 cloves

instructions: Put everything in a small pan and whisk smooth.
Simmer gently, stirring, for 5 minutes until glossy and thick.
Cool, jar and keep in the fridge for up to a month.

recipes.name: Pao Jiao (Sichuan Pickled Chilies)
recipes.flavorProfile: Sour, salty and hot, with a rounded fermented depth.
recipes.healthBenefit: A lacto-fermented pickle; chilies keep much of their vitamin C, and the brine is salty.

ingredients.cutPrep: whole, stems on, washed and dried

ingredients.prepNote: 1 tbsp taken up by the chilies, the rest stays in the brine
in place of Sichuan peppercorns, which the database does not hold

ingredients.baseName: Alcoholic beverage, spirit, ~40% v/v, all (Brandy, Gin, Rum, Vodka and Whisky)
ingredients.prepNote: baijiu is traditional

instructions: Dissolve the salt in the cooled boiled water in a clean pickling jar. Add the ginger, peppercorns and spirit.
Push the chilies under the brine, weight them down and close the jar, using a water-seal lid if you have one.
Leave at cool room temperature for 2 to 3 weeks, until sour. Keep the brine going with fresh vegetables. One serving is 20 g of chilies.

nutritionHighlights.note: Chilies keep much of their vitamin C in the brine.
Salty: count it if you watch sodium.

recipes.name: Suan Dou Jiao (Pickled Long Beans)
recipes.healthBenefit: A lacto-fermented pickle that brings fiber; the brine is salty.

ingredients.prepNote: 1 tbsp taken up by the beans, the rest stays in the brine

ingredients.baseName: Alcoholic beverage, spirit, ~40% v/v, all (Brandy, Gin, Rum, Vodka and Whisky)
ingredients.prepNote: baijiu is traditional

instructions: Dissolve the salt in the cooled boiled water in a clean jar and add the ginger, chilies and spirit.
Coil the beans into the jar under the brine, weight them down and close.
Leave at cool room temperature for 5 to 7 days, until sour and olive green. One serving is 20 g of beans.

nutritionHighlights.note: Salty: count it if you watch sodium.

recipes.name: Chen Pi (Dried Citrus Peel)
recipes.flavorProfile: Bittersweet, fragrant and citrusy, deepening as it ages.
recipes.healthBenefit: Used a piece at a time for flavor; it adds almost nothing but aroma.

ingredients.cutPrep: peel of about 8 oranges, white pith scraped thin
ingredients.prepNote: mandarin peel is traditional; the database has orange peel

instructions: Scrape away most of the white pith and cut the peel into pieces.
Dry in the sun or a 50 C (120 F) oven until brittle, a few days in the sun or about 6 hours in the oven.
Keep in a closed jar; it improves with age. Soak a piece in warm water for 20 minutes before using.

recipes.name: Xian Ya Dan (Salted Duck Eggs)
recipes.flavorProfile: Very salty whites and rich, sandy, orange yolks.
recipes.healthBenefit: Duck eggs are rich in protein, vitamin B12 and selenium; salting makes them very high in sodium.

ingredients.prepNote: 3 tbsp taken up by the eggs, the rest stays in the brine

instructions: Boil the water with the salt until dissolved and cool completely.
Put the eggs in a clean jar, pour the brine over, weight them under and close.
Leave in a cool place for 30 to 40 days. Steam or boil before eating.

nutritionHighlights.note: Duck eggs are rich in B12.
Very high; one egg carries most of a day's worth.

recipes.name: Xian Dan Huang (Salted Egg Yolks)
recipes.flavorProfile: Rich, sandy and savory, the center of zongzi and mooncakes.
recipes.healthBenefit: Egg yolk brings vitamins A, D and B12 and choline; salting makes it high in sodium.

ingredients.cutPrep: from 12 eggs brined whole, whites set aside for another dish
ingredients.prepNote: duck yolks are traditional; the database has chicken yolk
3 tbsp taken up by the yolks, the rest stays in the brine

instructions: Brine 12 whole duck eggs as for salted duck eggs, 30 to 40 days.
Crack them, keep the whites for another dish and lift out the firm yolks.
Rinse each yolk, brush with a little spirit if you like and bake at 150 C (300 F) for 8 minutes before using.

nutritionHighlights.note: Egg yolk is one of the richest sources of choline.

recipes.name: Dou Sha (Sweet Red Bean Paste)
recipes.flavorProfile: Sweet, earthy and smooth, with the taste of adzuki beans.
recipes.healthBenefit: Adzuki beans bring fiber, folate and plant protein, alongside the sugar.

ingredients.prepNote: peanut oil or lard is also used

instructions: Simmer the soaked beans in the water for about 1 1/2 hours, until they crush easily, topping up the water if needed.
Blend or mash, skins and all.
Cook the paste in a nonstick pan with the sugar, adding the oil a spoonful at a time, stirring constantly, until it is thick and pulls away from the pan, about 30 minutes.
Cool and keep in the fridge a week or freeze.

recipes.name: Lap Cheong (Chinese Sausage)
recipes.flavorProfile: Sweet, salty and fragrant, firm from drying, with diced fat that melts when cooked.
recipes.healthBenefit: Pork brings protein and B vitamins; the sausage is sweet and fatty, so it seasons a dish.

ingredients.cutPrep: cut in 5 mm dice, blanched and drained

ingredients.baseName: Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)
ingredients.prepNote: light soy

ingredients.baseName: Alcoholic beverage, spirit, ~40% v/v, all (Brandy, Gin, Rum, Vodka and Whisky)
ingredients.prepNote: in place of rose wine (mei kuei lu chiew), which the database does not hold

ingredients.baseName: Pork, offal and by-products, small intestine
ingredients.prepNote: about 2 m for 1 kg of filling

instructions: Mix the diced meat and fat with the sugar, salt, soy, spirit and white pepper and leave 1 hour.
Stuff into the hog casing, prick out any air and tie into 20 links of about 15 cm.

Hang in a cool, dry, airy place (or at 50 C, 122 F, in a low oven with the door ajar for the first day) for 7 to 10 days, until firm and about a third lighter. They keep a month in the fridge. Steam or slice into the dish.

recipes.name: Lap Yuk (Cantonese Cured Pork Belly)
recipes.flavorProfile: Sweet, salty and smoky-tasting pork belly, glossy and firm.
recipes.healthBenefit: Pork belly brings B vitamins; it is mostly fat, so a little seasons a pot of rice.

ingredients.baseName: Gris sidfläsk bit rå m. svål
ingredients.cutPrep: skin on, in strips 4 cm wide

ingredients.prepNote: all of it taken up by the meat

ingredients.baseName: Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)
ingredients.prepNote: light soy

ingredients.baseName: Alcoholic beverage, spirit, ~40% v/v, all (Brandy, Gin, Rum, Vodka and Whisky)
ingredients.prepNote: in place of rose wine (mei kuei lu chiew)

instructions: Mix the salt, sugar, soy, spirit and white pepper, coat the strips and leave in the fridge 1 day, turning twice.
Thread a string through one end of each strip and hang in a cool, dry, airy place for 7 to 10 days, until firm. Keep in the fridge up to a month.
Steam or slice into the dish. One serving is 50 g.

recipes.name: Wu Xiang Dougan (Spiced Dried Tofu)
recipes.flavorProfile: Firm, chewy and savoury, with five spice.
recipes.healthBenefit: Pressing concentrates the protein of tofu.

ingredients.baseName: Tofu, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride (nigari)
ingredients.cutPrep: pressed under a weight for 4 hours
ingredients.prepNote: about a third of the weight is pressed out as water

ingredients.baseName: Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)
ingredients.prepNote: about 3 tbsp
or a piece of cassia bark
or 3 whole cloves
stands in for Sichuan pepper, its close relative

instructions: Press the tofu between boards under a heavy weight for 4 hours, until firm and dense.
Simmer the water, soy sauce, sugar, salt and spices for 10 minutes. Add the pressed tofu and simmer gently 30 minutes, then leave in the liquid overnight.
Lift out and dry on a rack, or in a low oven, until the surface is firm. It makes about 700 g.

nutritionHighlights.note: About 15 g protein per 100 g serving.
Tofu set with calcium sulfate carries a good share of calcium.

recipes.curationNote: The simmering liquid is mostly not eaten; the full amount is counted, so salt is somewhat overstated. One serving is 100 g.

recipes.name: Bai Fu Ru (White Fermented Bean Curd)
recipes.flavorProfile: Creamy, salty and pungent, a little like strong cheese.
recipes.healthBenefit: Used a cube at a time as a seasoning; it is salty.

ingredients.baseName: Tofu, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride (nigari)
ingredients.cutPrep: pressed and cut in 2.5 cm cubes

ingredients.prepNote: rolled on the cubes, the rest dissolved in the brine they are kept and served in
baijiu, for dipping the cubes
optional
boiled and cooled, for the brine

instructions: Set the tofu cubes apart on a rack or straw in a covered box at 15 to 20 C (60 to 68 F) for 5 to 7 days, until each is covered in fine white mould.
Dip each cube in the baijiu, roll in salt mixed with the chilli, and pack into a sterilised jar.
Pour in the Shaoxing wine and water, close and leave 1 to 2 months before using.
recipes.curationNote: Home fermentation of tofu depends on the right mould; a cube that turns slimy, pink or black is thrown away. One serving is one cube, about 14 g.

recipes.name: Nam Yu (Red Fermented Bean Curd)
recipes.flavorProfile: Salty, winey and savoury, deep red.
recipes.healthBenefit: Used a cube at a time as a seasoning; it is salty.

ingredients.baseName: Tofu, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride (nigari)
ingredients.cutPrep: pressed and cut in 2.5 cm cubes

ingredients.prepNote: rolled on the cubes, the rest dissolved in the brine they are kept and served in
stands in for red yeast rice (hong qu), which colours the brine; no food database here lists it
boiled and cooled

instructions: Mould the tofu cubes as for white fermented bean curd, 5 to 7 days at 15 to 20 C (60 to 68 F).
Roll each in salt and pack into a sterilised jar. Grind the red yeast rice with the sugar, mix with the wine and water and pour over.
Close and leave 2 months before using. The red brine is used in cooking along with the cubes.
recipes.curationNote: Red yeast rice can contain monacolin K, the same compound as the statin lovastatin, in the small amounts used here. One serving is one cube with a little brine, about 18 g.

recipes.name: Douchi (Fermented Black Soybeans)
recipes.healthBenefit: A seasoning used by the spoonful; it is salty.

ingredients.prepNote: black soybeans are traditional; no food database here lists them dry, so yellow soybeans stand in
optional
optional

instructions: Steam the soaked beans 2 to 3 hours until soft. Spread on a tray, cover with a cloth and keep warm, about 30 C (86 F), for 5 to 7 days, until covered in yellow green mould.
Rinse off the loose mould, mix the beans with the salt, ginger and wine, and pack into a jar. Leave 2 to 4 weeks.
Spread out and dry in the sun or a low oven until dry and wrinkled. It makes about 650 g.
recipes.curationNote: One serving is one tablespoon, about 10 g, from about 650 g finished.
